The error is `not found` — not an auth issue. The image doesn't exist in the registry. The build claimed success but the image tag doesn't match or wasn't pushed correctly.

Check if the image actually exists in Artifact Registry:

```bash
# List images in the crewai-dev repo
gcloud artifacts docker images list europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/kd-ix-eur-dev-gke/crewai-dev --include-tags 2>/dev/null | grep customerintelligence

# Check if the repo itself exists
gcloud artifacts repositories list --project=kd-ix-eur-dev-gke --location=europe-west1 --filter="name:crewai-dev"
```

The pod expects tag `-56` but the build log showed it built tag `-55`. The provisioner may have triggered a second build (deployment instance 56) that either failed or pushed to a different tag. That would explain why the Ansible said "success" for instance 55 but the pod is looking for instance 56.
